sections.heading: Balanced pattern
sections.content: A healthy eating pattern emphasizes vegetables, fruit, legumes, whole grains, nuts, and a variety of minimally processed foods. It limits excess salt, free sugars, and saturated or trans fats.

sections.heading: Practical swaps
sections.content: Useful steps include choosing water instead of sugary drinks, adding vegetables to meals, using unsaturated oils in modest amounts, and checking packaged foods for salt and sugar.

sections.heading: Personalization
sections.content: Nutrition advice should be adjusted for age, pregnancy, medical conditions, allergies, medicines, culture, budget, and clinician guidance. HealthOS AI should not prescribe a medical diet for a disease.
